question: If 9 ÷ 5 + 3 × 7 = 22 and 4 ÷ 7 + 2 × 15 = 29, then find the value of 14 ÷ 5 + 35 × 9.
solution:
The logic followed here is

 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
×

 
 
 

 
 
**Code**

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 
+

 
 
 

 

i) 9 ÷ 5 + 3 × 7 = 22

 
• On decoding, 9 × 5 ÷ 3 + 7 = 15 + 7 = 22 (Here, 5 ÷ 3 will give us decimal values, so we will do 9 × 5 first and then divided by 3 to get 15.)

ii) 4 ÷ 7 + 2 × 15 = 29

 
• On decoding, 4 × 7 ÷ 2 + 15 = 14 + 15 = 29

Similarly,14 ÷ 5 + 35 × 9. 

 
• On decoding 14 × 5 ÷ 35 + 9 = 2 + 9 = 11

Hence, '11' is the correct answer.
